description: In the four-point order with a,b below u,v, {a,b} has exactly the incomparable upper bounds u,v, each minimal among its upper bounds, and no supremum. The lower bounds of {u,v} are exactly the incomparable a,b, and there is no infimum.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.four_point_bounds :
  upperBounds {0, 1} = {2, 3} ∧
    lowerBounds {2, 3} = {0, 1} ∧
      IsAntichain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) {2, 3} ∧
        IsAntichain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) {0, 1} ∧
          (∀ x ∈ {2, 3}, Minimal (fun x => x ∈ upperBounds {0, 1}) x) ∧ (¬∃ x, IsLUB {0, 1} x) ∧ ¬∃ x, IsGLB {2, 3} x
